Complete-Flutter-App.name: Egg Fried Rice
step: Mince the garlic and loosen the cooked rice. Beat the egg in a bowl.
Heat the oil in a pan. Cook the garlic briefly, add the egg and scramble until set.
Add rice and soy sauce. Stir-fry until the rice is steaming hot throughout, then serve.

Complete-Flutter-App.name: Bread and Butter Pudding
step: Heat the oven to 180 C. Butter the bread and arrange it in a small ovenproof dish.
Whisk the milk, egg and sugar. Pour over the bread and let it soak for 5 minutes.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the custard is set throughout. Allow to cool slightly before serving.
